topicA: B2B SEO in the Age of AI Search

recap.intro: This week you explored two areas of B2B marketing: how AI is changing search engine optimization and the evolving world of demand generation.
bullets: Even with new AI search tools, businesses that focus on being clear and trustworthy online are well-prepared.
Many B2B marketing teams are no longer using the total number of early-stage leads as their main measure of success.
Building brand trust is becoming even more important, as people often choose a brand they know even if AI suggests another.
Poor customer data and disagreements between marketing and sales can lead to a significant loss of potential customers.
recap.closing: This week you learned that while technology evolves, foundational principles like trust, data quality, and clear goals remain crucial for B2B marketing success.
